newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks resume retreat as Wall Street drops.
newsitem.headline: French stocks resume retreat as Wall Street drops.

text.p: French stocks resumed their retreat in late afternoon trading on Friday after Wall Street gave up its early gains and shed 50 points.

The blue-chip CAC-40 index, which had begun to recover from the day's losses on signs that Wall Street may rebound, was down 1.2 percent at 2,185.99 at 1510 GMT. The December CAC-40 futures contract was 21 points lower at 2,194.
Traders said the bourse was a very nervous market but they said the CAC had strong support at 2,170 points.
